newHolds.reason: Both apraclonidine and brimonidine can cause lid retraction; the unqualified stem does not identify a unique answer.
The historical SIADH question treats water loading as a routine diagnostic test; this is unsafe or inappropriate in many hyponatraemic patients.
Mutation-detection methods and mutation type are insufficiently specified; no publisher key.
The absolute earliest-wasting muscle claim is insufficiently supported across knee-osteoarthritis presentations.
The source includes incorrect 25-alpha hydroxylation terminology and disputed vitamin-D requirements; do not repair distractors silently.
Mixed-phenotype leukaemia classification needs lineage-marker intensity and context beyond this fragment; no publisher key.
Fourth choice unrecalled; two displayed depression choices overlap.
Aortic-stenosis intervention decision lacks mean gradient, valve area, LV function and adequate symptom context.
A universal two-hour PT handling requirement is not established without the laboratory protocol and anticoagulant context.
Historical PMTCT choices do not represent a complete contemporary maternal/infant regimen and several listed drugs can participate in ART.
Fourth distractor is unrecalled.
Historical investigational erectile-dysfunction use would be confused with the current approved bremelanotide indication by this unqualified stem.
Endothelial-cell-loss percentage lacks a follow-up time and technique, both of which materially change the answer.
Bacitracin susceptibility is a presumptive historic discriminator, not definitive establishment of group-A streptococcal diagnosis.
Shearing and avulsion overlap in flaying/degloving; the alternatives mix mechanism and resulting injury.
Very marked microcytosis and high ferritin do not uniquely discriminate chronic-inflammation anaemia from thalassaemia or mixed disease.
The aplastic-leukaemia option is corrupted; it is not silently replaced with aplastic anaemia.
Supplied letter B conflicts with the accompanying serous-carcinoma answer text and displayed option order.
Anterior-chamber cells and flare alone at two weeks do not uniquely establish postoperative endophthalmitis or its organism.
